Rise of the Six Solo

​
Introduction
This guide assumes you understand the basics of combat, equipment, and the RotS fight, including mechanics as explained in #rise-of-the-six-basic.
​
⬥  is a very crucial part of RotS, this relic allows you to start every kill at full adrenaline without  and 
⬥ At RotS the meta is to AoE the brothers down as fast as possible
⬥ Most of the meta and strategy revolve around stacking and luring the brothers so that they can be killed at the same time
​
Useful Unlocks
⬥ Double  and  /  unlocked is crucial for high kph
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equipment with the  should also be used for this purpose
⬥ Equipment with  and  for a flat 7% and 15% (for 10 seconds) respectively
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Both the perk and sigil work against the brothers
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Take note that  and  do now work against the brothers
​

Note: may use delver's anklet if having issues with run energy
​
Melee

⬥ Solo should be consistently ~30 seconds if done correctly.
⬥ At 24 seconds you will get a message that says "As there is no-one on one side of the shadow portal, it empowers the brothers to destroy everyone!"
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once this happens you can then kill the brothers on the side you start at
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will hop over and be targetable at 27 seconds
⬥ You are required to have these buffs for this rotation to work:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer ability  and Undead Slayer perk 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Undead Slayer task (reduced to 1) alongside Genocidal perk 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Task will not deplete
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Fort Forinthry Guardhouse Slayer Upgrades
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ghost Hunter Helm, Backpack, Legs    and Salve Amulet 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Equilibrium perk 
​
Rotation

​
Notes:
⬥ Do not stall anything, just let it run you to the northernmost brother and release the   and on global cooldown use 
⬥ Btc means backwards target cycle
⬥ You must be on the following brother rotation:
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• West Side: Dharok, Guthan and Verac
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• East Side: Ahrim, Karil and Torag
​
Necromancy
⬥ Solo should be consistently sub 33.6 seconds if done correctly.
⬥ You wear  before the hop so you don't overkill the brothers with the rotation.
⬥ At 24 seconds you will get a message that says "As there is no-one on one side of the shadow portal, it empowers the brothers to destroy everyone!"
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once this happens you can then kill the brothers on the side you start at
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• They will hop over and be targetable at 27 seconds
⬥ You should never start on the side in which Karil is on as he will delay the kill significantly
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The ideal brother rotation is: West - Ahrim, Guthan, Verac. East - Karil, Dharok, Torag
⬥ Whilst waiting the 24 seconds you need to get 5  stacks
